# gyro_locations (Data Source)

Regions that have orderable products.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gyro_locations" "all" {}

output "regions" {
  value = { for l in data.gyro_locations.all.locations : l.region => "${l.city}, ${l.country}" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `locations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String)
- `code` (String) Deprecated: legacy location code. Use region.
- `country` (String) ISO country code.
- `region` (String) Region name (gyro_server.region), e.g. eu-de-1, tr-ist-1.
- `zone` (String)
